hypothesis: On forward 30m STRAT_212_CONTINUATION episodes that pass the unchanged floor_ge1r activation rule, the frozen first-sight underlying path has a describable R distribution. This draft does not claim that distribution is an edge.

baseline.label: main at draft registration; #1114 did not change the closed options experiment

candidate.change: Measure floor_ge1r first-sight underlying paths once with options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1, after the forward stopping rule, from sealed path records, without a second target variant or an option fill model.
candidate.label: floor_ge1r first-sight underlying outcome — options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1

data.source: Sealed options_212c_floor_outcome_path-v0.1 session files only: the episode snapshot plus the 5-minute bars. Scored only by options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1. Ordinary ep-v0.1 and out-v0.1 files are not an input. No retrospective file is an input.

window.end: stop after the session in which floor_ge1r activations first reach 25, including that full session, or after 60 NYSE sessions, whichever comes first

held_constant: floor_ge1r rule find_targets(min_target_rr=1.0)

execution.entry_logic: measured_entry_price = first_sight_price. The stored Strat entry_trigger is structural setup context only and must not be substituted as the fill. Activation means gate_bucket_floor == WOULD_OTHERWISE_QUALIFY at first sight. Activation is not permission to choose a retrospectively better fill.
execution.exit_logic: Scorer options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1, not out-v0.1. Same regular session only. TARGET_FIRST uses floor target_1_r, never an open beyond the target. INVALIDATION_FIRST uses the open's R when the bar opens beyond the stop, otherwise the invalidation's R versus measured_entry_price. A bar that reaches both stop and Target 1 is AMBIGUOUS and is excluded. Timeout is UNRESOLVED_AT_CLOSE at close_r versus measured_entry_price. DATA_INVALID is excluded. No trailing exit and no Target 2 exit.
execution.stop_logic: Stored invalidation, scored by options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1 from the sealed episode snapshot and sealed bars only. If the 5-minute bar opens beyond the stop and does not reach Target 1, INVALIDATION_FIRST at the R of that open versus measured_entry_price; the stop price inside the gap is not a fill. If the bar reaches both the stop and Target 1, including a gap that spans both, AMBIGUOUS with flag gap_or_range_spans_stop_and_target. A non-gap touch of the stop uses the invalidation price. A missing snapshot field, hash mismatch, or bar outside the frozen 5-minute grid is DATA_INVALID and is not repaired by a later refetch.
execution.target_logic: Unchanged floor_ge1r target_1. If the bar opens beyond Target 1 and does not reach the stop, TARGET_FIRST at target_1_r; the open beyond Target 1 is not a fill. If that open is also beyond Target 2, record Target 2 as reached and still use target_1_r. Target 2 is not an exit. A gap through Target 2 that also reaches the stop is AMBIGUOUS.
execution.sizing: None. One underlying R per completed activation. No portfolio, overlap, or drawdown model.
execution.friction: No dollar P&L and no added slippage. R uses structural risk as the denominator and the first-sight price as the entry. Stage B option fills are NOT EVALUATED.

notes: DRAFT registration only. Not collection and not scoring. Stage A scorer is options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1. The one-look input is the sealed episode snapshot plus the sealed 5-minute bars in options_212c_floor_outcome_path-v0.1 under logs/research_sealed/T-2026-10-02-prereg-options-212c-floor-outcome-2026-10-02-01/path-records/options_212c_floor_outcome_path-v0.1/. The 5-minute grid starts at the first full bar with start >= first_sight_at and ends at the last bar whose end is <= session_close. Canonical identity includes direction. 25 activations includes the full threshold-crossing session and is not an exact final-N. Missing snapshot or bar-grid data is DATA_INVALID and must not be repaired by a later refetch. Ordinary out-v0.1 files are not the authoritative outcome. measured_entry_price = first_sight_price. Before the one look the only visible study fields are sessions_elapsed, stop_condition_met, and advance_refused, plus the stopping-condition name once it fires. The monitor counts activations only from the hash-verified sealed snapshot. Seals must be consecutive eligible NYSE sessions from 2026-10-05, and an unknown gate refuses instead of counting as a non-activation. Direction and the activation count stay hidden. Acceptance and rejection criteria are null. Written results are INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE below 15 completed outcomes and DESCRIPTIVE MEASUREMENT at 15 or more. This is forward Stage A descriptive evidence, not a confirmatory edge test. Stage B is NOT EVALUATED. No drawdown. Approval and scoring are blocked until options_212c_floor_outcome-v0.1 emits every required_metrics field and validation refuses a completed one-look when any field is absent. The generic runner does not implement that scorer. Do not start this trial's collection until this registration is on main. The closed 59-episode trial stays closed. Synthetic-only capture/scoring primitives may be implemented for QA while status is DRAFT, but no provider fetch, file writer/reader, timer/service hook, experiment adapter, collection, or real scoring is authorized.
